summary.text: Mark Legvold is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota State Senate, District 58, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Bill Lieske (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a family farmer, a 33-year U.S. Air Force veteran and a former educator in Saint Paul Public Schools.

paragraphs.text: Mark Legvold graduated from Northfield High School, earned an associate degree from the Community College of the Air Force in 2016, a bachelor's degree from Hamline University in 1997, and a graduate degree from Minnesota State University, Mankato in 2007.
Ballotpedia lists his service in the U.S. Air National Guard from 1990 to 2023 and his profession as farmer and small business owner.

In the survey, Legvold listed an affordable Minnesota, preventing fraud, support for veterans and military families, public school funding, the agricultural economy and small businesses among his priorities.
